name: Gravewatcher Chainmail
body:
Source Inner Sea Gods pg. 251
Aura moderate divination, evocation, and necromancy CL 7th
Slot armor; Price 5,380 gp; Weight 40 lbs.
Description
This blue-white +1 deathlessUE chainmail is made of an intricate pattern of light and dark links that form the shape of Pharasma’s spiral on the armor’s chest. The wearer can use detect undead, disrupt undead, and light each once per day.
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, death ward, detect undead, disrupt undead, light; Price 2,840 gp
